title: Branch totals with GROUP BY and HAVING
summary: Aggregate per group, filter rows with WHERE and groups with HAVING.

tests.name: only live loans, only busy branches

hints: WHERE runs before grouping (it removes rows). HAVING runs after grouping (it removes whole groups). The status filter is a WHERE; the 'at least 3 loans' rule is a HAVING.
Keep `sum(amount)` as it is. Casting it changes how the numbers print, and the check compares them exactly.
